3180201.text: Did... did you just feel the power of Geo?

3180202.text: Your connection to the elements is so different from the Vision bearers'! Seems like you can physically switch between elements...

3180203.text: If so, then you just need to make an offering to a Statue of The Seven and the elements will respond — just like they did in Mondstadt.

3180204.text: We're now in Liyue, which is ruled over by the Geo Archon. That's why the statues here look a bit different.

3180205.text: If you ever miss using your Anemo powers, you can just get them back from a Statue of The Seven in Mondstadt.
